clue.text: Though sometimes rough, one's always precious

definitions.text: Though sometimes rough, one's always precious

parts.words: Though sometimes rough, one's always precious
parts.note: a gem that comes out of the ground uncut, and a 'rough' one is also a good-hearted but unpolished person, yet the stone is always precious

explanation.surface: A grudging tribute to someone unpolished but valuable.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'rough diamond' is a gem not yet cut, and also a kind-hearted person with rough manners.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes the precious gemstone, which is found rough before it is cut.

clue.text: Furniture put up on time —- that's outstanding

indicators.note: put up in a down clue means the word is written upwards, reversed

parts.note: a bed is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Furniture bought on credit leaves a bill unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: Money owed and not yet paid is said to be outstanding.

clue.text: Dreadful or excellent?

definitions.meaning: inspiring dread or fearful reverence, the older sense
the slang sense, meaning great or brilliant

explanation.definitionFit: The word once meant inspiring terror and now in slang means terrific.

clue.text: Arduous task moving old pigment

indicators.note: moving means one letter shifts to a new place in the word

parts.note: a chore is a tedious, hard task

explanation.surface: A tiresome job of shifting some ancient paint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' shifts the O of CHORE to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochre, an earthy yellow-brown colouring, has been used since cave painting.

clue.text: Planning to make classical number in slightly changed design

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other
slightly changed means the word's letters are rearranged

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Fitting a Roman numeral into a tweaked design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slightly changed' makes DESING from the clue's own word; 'in' then signals the Roman six splitting it after DE. 'to make' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Working out a scheme is plotting or contriving it.

clue.text: A happy occasion we had, with sound of bells?

parts.note: 'we had' shortens to we'd
ding is the ringing noise of a bell

explanation.surface: Someone recalls a joyful event with church bells ringing.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage ceremony is the classic joyful event.

clue.text: A new addition in part of house that's in decline

indicators.note: in means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a wing is a section of a large house

explanation.surface: An extension built onto a house that is falling apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'addition' is surface glue: A and N are both placed inside WING.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting smaller or weaker, like the moon after full, is fading.

clue.text: Pursue girl to give flower

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely
Violet is a girl's name

explanation.surface: Chase a girl to give her a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The dog violet is a scentless wild violet.

clue.text: Understood brief report on Matilda's wickedness

annotationWithheld.why: Understood brief report on Matilda's wickedness (7): LIED is Matilda's wickedness (Belloc's girl who told lies), but no reading makes 'brief report' give IMP
annotationWithheld.clue: Understood brief report on Matilda's wickedness

clue.text: Outdoor furniture Great Danes destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means wrecked, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Big dogs have wrecked the garden furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' rearranges the letters of GREAT DANES.
explanation.definitionFit: A bench for outdoors is set among the lawns and flower beds.

clue.text: To be, he composed, venerable to the end

definitions.text: To be, he composed, venerable to the end

indicators.note: composed means put together or arranged, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: Ven. is the abbreviation for Venerable, a church title

explanation.surface: A great composer is honoured as revered right up to his death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' rearranges TO BE HE into BEETHO; VEN, short for Venerable, comes at the end, as 'to the end' says. The whole clue also describes the man.
explanation.definitionFit: The great German composer, revered to the end of his life.

clue.text: Person fully prepared to swallow mollusc

definitions.meaning: someone who stares open-mouthed, as if ready to gulp something down
a large burrowing clam whose shell gapes open

explanation.surface: Someone ready to gulp down a shellfish whole.
explanation.definitionFit: One who stares open-mouthed is so called, and a gaping-shelled clam has the same name.

clue.text: Love-poetry by partners — with it, I have become very easily affected

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, a nought
verse means poetry
N and S, North and South, are partners at bridge
taken as written
'I have' shortens to I've

explanation.surface: A lovestruck writer of romantic poems has become hopelessly touchy.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone too easily hurt or moved is overly touchy.

clue.text: Enough drink to make acrobat almost blotto

parts.note: a tumbler is an acrobat who does somersaults

indicators.note: almost means not quite all, so the final letter goes

parts.note: full is slang for drunk, as is blotto

explanation.surface: A drink big enough to leave an acrobat nearly sozzled.
explanation.definitionFit: The quantity a drinking glass holds.

clue.text: Like an eternity ring?

parts.note: a ring is a circle with no finish, which is also what eternity means: going on for ever

explanation.surface: A question about a jeweller's band of stones.
explanation.definitionFit: A circle never finishes, just as eternity goes on for ever.

clue.text: Engraver passes printing fluid with hesitation

parts.note: passes means dies, as in passes away
ink is the fluid used in printing
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: An engraver dies, hesitating, with ink on his hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutter of dies, the stamps for coins and medals, is a kind of engraver.

clue.text: Name of wife embraced by gleeful spouse, originally?

indicators.note: embraced by means held inside, so one piece goes within the other
originally points to the opening letters of the two words before it

parts.note: lady is an old term for a wife, as in 'his lady'

explanation.surface: A woman's name held fondly by a cheerful husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes G and S from 'gleeful spouse'; 'embraced by' puts LADY between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladys is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Monarch left holding nothing of particular territory

indicators.note: holding means containing, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Regina is Latin for queen, a reigning monarch
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A ruler keeps a region with nothing in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to an area or district rather than the whole country.

clue.text: Creature noted for eagerness to live, say

parts.note: to be means to exist or live
aver means to state or say

explanation.surface: An animal famous for enthusiasm to stay alive, as it were.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eager beaver' is the idiom behind the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase eager beaver makes this dam-building rodent the byword for keenness.

clue.text: Nevertheless (as used around US city street)

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so one piece goes about the other

parts.note: taken as written
NY is short for New York
way is a road or street, as in Broadway

explanation.surface: A note that a word is said around a New York street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts NYWAY between A and S; the brackets also hint that the form is American usage.
explanation.definitionFit: This informal American form of 'anyway' means all the same.

clue.text: Summit almost reached by support column's section

indicators.note: reached by means the next piece follows on
almost means not quite all, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: vertex means the highest point or summit
a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: A peak nearly gained by a support column's section.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts VERTEX to VERTE; the spinal column is meant, not a building's pillar.
explanation.definitionFit: A bone of the spine is one segment of the backbone.

clue.text: Get this instrument in key as quickly

parts.note: B is a musical key
as soon means as quickly or as early

explanation.surface: Tune up this instrument in the right key as fast as possible.
explanation.definitionFit: The bassoon is a low woodwind instrument.

clue.text: Bad feeling in a game with our side

parts.note: nim is a game of taking matches from piles
us means our side, the speakers' team

explanation.surface: Resentment brewing during a game against our side.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostility or ill will.

clue.text: Translation of Parisian landmark to this heavenly place

definitions.meaning: the Champs-Elysees, the Paris avenue, rendered into English
the paradise of Greek myth where blessed souls dwell

explanation.surface: Turning a famous Paris avenue into English leads to paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: The Champs-Elysees means the fields of Elysium, the Greek paradise for heroes.

clue.text: Cautious in general, going over tracks

indicators.note: in a down answer, going over means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
RY is short for railway, a set of tracks

explanation.surface: A general picks his way carefully across railway lines.
explanation.definitionFit: Wary or suspicious.

clue.text: A young couple originally married in distant county

annotationWithheld.why: A young couple originally married in distant county (4): M + AY gives MAY, but no clue word accounts for the final O of MAYO
annotationWithheld.clue: A young couple originally married in distant county

clue.text: Honest chap, fellow with class

parts.note: rank means class or standing

explanation.surface: A decent man, a fellow of some standing.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank means candid, and it is also a man's first name, so it is a candid chap.

clue.text: State nominates constituents for resettlement

indicators.note: the component letters are to be resettled, moved into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A US state picks its candidates, the voters being relocated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents for resettlement' rearranges the letters of NOMINATES.
explanation.definitionFit: Minnesota is a Midwestern US state.

clue.text: Bright lights and temptations ensnaring a paragon of virtue

indicators.note: ensnaring means trapping, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: lures are enticements or temptations
ST is the abbreviation for saint, a model of virtue

explanation.surface: Glittering city lights tempt even a saintly person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ensnaring' signals the container. 'Bright lights' reads like city glamour but simply means gleams; 'a paragon of virtue' is the usual crossword pointer to a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustres are glosses or gleams, and also glass-drop chandeliers.

clue.text: Violently criticise part of play intolerantly

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Harsh attack on a performance staged with bigotry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part of' points to the letters inside 'play intolerantly'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means attack fiercely, in words or blows.
